comment: Great professor take her! She's nice and very lenient with a lot of things if you struggle in class. Quizzes are straightforward and she prepares you for exams well. Pretty lenient grading and she's very nice.

Dr. Russell is the best. If you are taking any class and she is teaching a section, you should take her. The class was set up very clearly, and she truly wants you to succeed. And, if you need help with the HW or an in-class problem, she can explain the answer clearly and will get back you quickly (even over email).

Most amazing math professor. She cares so much about her students and is willing to meet with you and help you out. She truly wants you to succeed. Her lectures are clear and tests/quizzes are what you would expect (no surprises or material that was not covered) so are not overwhelming. If you pay attention and do your work you will be successful.

Dr Russell is an amazing professor! She makes difficult subjects so easy to understand. She is a really fair grader and always gives you partial credit wherever she can. She is so helpful outside of class and wants everyone to do well. One of the best professors at UR
Great lectures and very accessible outside of class. Lots of guided practice in class really helps concepts mesh. Overall just a great prof.

Dr. Russell is a great professor. She is regarded by most as the best professor in Richmond's math department. Multivariate is not an easy course though; it's very abstract and you have to put a lot of time into it. Her office hours really help though. She also has very good communicative and relating skills that math professors don't usually have.

Dr. Russell is one of the top 3 best profs in the Math Dept by far!! Not only is she a brilliant woman but she is also a very caring one. She is one of the few profs that make a genuine effort to get to know their students. Her lectures are super helpful and her expectations quite normal on HW, quizzes, and exams!! Make good use of her office hours

Doctor Russell is a professor that tries her very best to get students interested in the subject. She has many office hours to reach her and she also has a positive attitude in and out of the classroom. The quizzes are the hardest for me, but are do-able if you study. She assigns a reasonable amount of homework. Highly recommend taking this class.
Professor Russel is an amazing professor. Math is a hard subject to teach well, but she does it flawlessly. Her notes are organized clearly making it easy to study the material come test time.

She is indeed one of the best Math professors at UR. She is good at explaining and always willing to help. She will take time to make sure you completely understand the materials and trust me there are rewards if you put into efforts. You can't go wrong with taking her!

Dr. Russel is one of the best math professors at UR!! Sometimes, her sense of humor is annoying, but I do believe she made Multivariate Calculus less harder than it is. She's also very good at 3D drawing and trust me, this is going to help you A LOT understand the concept of Multivariate Calculus!
She is such an awesome teacher. She explains everything so well and the tests are so easy.... Easy A as long as you come to class.

Dr. Russell is my favorite teacher. She is enthusiastic about the material and very willing to help. The class starts relatively easy and gets harder by the end. There is homework every class, but it is very manageable. There is a quiz once a week, but they are easy. The class is difficult, but Dr. Russell makes it excellent. I recommend.

Great professor, definitely recommend take math 235 with her. Clear lecture, and she will explain the principles of those concepts. She makes me more interested in Math. Accessible outside of the class, and her dog is cute. Test and quizzes are easy, as long as you put in some work. She won't make you to solve long and difficult integrals in test.

Really good at answering questions. People would ask really tough questions and she could answer them very clearly on the spot, often with visual examples. Made Calc III a lot easier to grasp than I would have predicted going into the class. Gotta do the homework and do well on the weekly quizzes; seems a lot more intimidating than it really is.

Definitely my coolest and best professor. Dr. Russell makes herself available to help her students, whether it's during her office hours or by email. She simplifies complex topics and applies them to our potential majors in her explanations. If a topic is unclear, she does not give up until she can clarify it for her students.

Dr. Russell is one of the best teachers I have ever had, she is committed to helping her students truly understand Calculus. She is very willing to meet with her students outside the classroom and she made a somewhat challenging subject fun to learn.
New UR prof. Glad I took her class
